operation: Print and check the test square
notes: Print patterns/print_letter/00_PRINT_FIRST_test_square.pdf at 100 %. The solid square must read 100 mm (+/- 1 mm) both ways, the dashed one 4 in. Do not cut from a wrong-scale print.

notes: Make a 150 x 150 mm swatch of each stack and set tension until the lock sits mid-stack on both faces: (a) ULTRA + 330D body seam, tex 90 / Nm 110 R, 8 SPI; (b) Hypalon on ULTRA, double row; (c) 25 mm box-X tex 135 / Nm 140 R, 7 SPI; (d) 70D / mesh at 10 SPI. Keep them in the QC folder.

The bag's load points are sewn only after these pass.

operation: Cut 77 fabric / sheet pieces
notes: Per cutting_plan.csv: lay face up (one way for camo and mesh), L+R pieces face to face, cut windows, slots and slits FIRST, knife clockwise from the grain arrow. Notches 6 mm, never past the seam line. Hypalon, TPU-840D and HDPE from the DXF on the laser / router.

notes: Cut lengths in cutting_plan.csv (crown kit M shown; B-28 and W3 per crown kit). Use the J8 stop; seal both ends; no hard bead wider than the webbing.

operation: Mark every placement
notes: Chalk / silver pen on the INSIDE unless the pattern says OUTSIDE; awl the drill marks (box corners, slit ends, window corners, zip stops). Pieces: B-01, B-03 (L only / R only marks), B-02h, B-02door, B-02u, B-06f, B-29a.

operation: FP mouth band and shock-cord channel
needle: Nm 90/14 DPx17, medium ball SUK (knit mesh)
notes: Sew FP-b to the FP-a top (260 mm), fold the band on its fold line over the seam, edge-stitch 2 mm to form the channel; thread the shock cord (FP-cord) and bar it at both ends inside the side allowance.

operation: B-18 doublers + HE hinge eyes (DECISION HE-ONE / HE-PIN, sketch SK-8)

(2) B-18 ROWS FIRST: lay B-18 INSIDE B-01 on the drawn placement, coated face to B-01, its lower edge ON the B-01 cut edge (it runs 12 mm below the floor seam line); sew its perimeter rows 3 and 9 mm in, on the TOP and BOTH SIDES only (the bottom goes in the floor seam), through B-18 + B-01 ONLY [WF2; Nm 110/18 DPx17, round point R; bonded_nylon_tex90; ISO 301, 8 SPI; rated rows (load_points B-18)]. Nothing else is on the panel yet: these rows must never catch the HE. (3) PLACE THE HE: fold the strip in half on the 'EYE FOLD' line (raw ends together, neck folds inside) and lay it OUTSIDE B-01 over B-18, centred on the 'hinge eye CL' notch, eye fold pointing UP, both raw ends ON the B-01 cut edge. Layer order from outside: HE leg / HE leg / B-01 / B-18. Clip. (4) BOX: box-X 34 x 7 at the drawn 'HE hinge eye' box (drill corners: its lower edge 4 mm, its top 11 mm above the floor seam line), through all four layers [BT / PS (prototype: WF2 + J1 template); Nm 140/22 DPx17, round point R; bonded_nylon_tex135; ISO 301, box-X path 7 SPI]. Its top edge must stay BELOW the fairlead cheeks: nothing but the 18 mm neck may sit above +16 mm. (5) BASTE the bottom of the stack (2 HE raw ends + B-18 + B-01) at 6 mm, inside the allowance, so op 4.15 catches all of it [WF1; Nm 110/18 DPx17, round point R; bonded_nylon_tex90; ISO 301, 6 mm stitch]. The free loop above the box (25 mm, fold 36 mm above the seam line) is the eye: it points UP and takes the z 60 pin with the 18 mm neck in the 20 mm throat and the 3-ply neck through the 5.5 mm gap under the pin (DECISION HE-ENV, BL-042 hinge fairlead; loaded pin centre 25.1 mm above the seam line, HE-FIT band 22-29). No stitching crosses the eye after step 3.
